headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE beautiful Chrome extension store promo tile in exact LANDSCAPE 11:7 rectangle (target 1760x1120 px), not a panorama. Concept 06: TRANSPARENT NATIVE LIVE CHAT, calm atmospheric original indie-game lake.

Two provided reference images are solely STYLE REFERENCES for the REAL YouTube chat anatomy and its semitransparent treatment. BORROW just the native chat visual language. Do NOT reproduce actual streamer, actual game, actual usernames, actual comments, or footage. This is entirely original promotional illustration.

Composition: a fullscreen painted indie adventure-game landscape fills the whole 11:7 rectangle, deep teal forest, still luminous mountain lake, soft warm light breaking through the trees and a tiny original cloaked adventurer at lower-left. A spacious patch of darker green in upper-left carries a huge immaculate modern sans-serif heading:
"Fullscreen" in white on the first line
"Live Chat" in RED on the second line.
Verbatim exact words. Both very prominent and immediately legible in a 440x280 thumbnail. Below the heading a small sentence "More stream. Less distraction." in soft white.
The right roughly 35% of tile shows ONE native YouTube Live Chat pane IN the fullscreen video scene, not alongside a window. Rectangle with nearly-square modest 3px corners. Background near-black at 40% opacity, gently blurred view through it: the tree trunks and teal lake remain visibly recognizable THROUGH the chat. This is transparent dark UI overlay, NOT frosted whiteglass, not a neon holo HUD. Text still crisp white and legible.
Native header: "Top chat" and small down-chevron, vertical ⋮ far right. Very fine horizontal divider.
7 compact native rows, round avatar on left. Muted gray @handle immediately followed on the SAME SINGLE row by white comment:
"@alex beautiful"
"@mira love this"
"@sam let's go!"
"@luna so peaceful"
"@kai nice view"
"@jules wow"
"@rin great stream"
Equal compact row spacing like actual YouTube live chat. No separated speech bubbles. No large colored cards. No gray filler placeholder bars.
Native bottom composer: own little round avatar beside thin UNDERLINED "Chat..." input, smiley outline plus outlined triangular send icon. It must feel typeable and real. One thin native progress bar and subtle playback/fullscreen controls can line the bottom of video, unobtrusive. Flat, elegant, photo/editorial-quality game illustration with the UI chrome restrained to native YouTube conventions. No official logos, real brands, streaming creator likeness, stats badges, product ratings, endorsement, physical monitor, desk, or gamer room. Preserve large coherent lake scene so transparency is instantly obvious. All typography safely within canvas edges.
revisionPrompts:
Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied original promotional art to fix ONLY its canvas composition and landscape aspect ratio. The previous image is TOO WIDE. Recompose it to a noticeably TALLER landscape tile, EXACT ratio 11:7, target dimensions 1760x1120. This is the small Chrome store tile format. Make the resulting rectangle only 1.5714 times as wide as high, never the current 2.5 panorama.
Preserve the existing original lake/forest art, the huge EXACT white "Fullscreen" and red "Live Chat", tiny "More stream. Less distraction.", the native near-black semitransparent YouTube Top chat pane with inline gray @handles and white comments and small circular avatars, footer underlined Chat... composer + smiley and outlined send triangle. Keep the fictional seven rows and clear tree/lake scenery showing THROUGH the panel. Keep the explorer lower-left and entire chat right. No real creator, no real game, no logos, no ratings.
Re-layout the artwork: narrower horizontal field, substantially deeper vertical lake/reflections and taller forest edges, heading in top-left 48%, chat pane right 40% with compact equal seven rows, wide original scenic area below the heading. Make the explorer occupy lower-left. Bottom player controls visible. Keep all text and full chat within canvas. Preserve native flat chat design, no message bubbles. Strong clear typography at 440x280. Do not merely put panorama inside a border or letterbox. Fill the full 11:7 canvas with the recomposed illustration. This aspect correction is the single requested change.
conceptNote: Original forest-lake adventure scene with restrained transparent native YouTube-style chat; landscape remains visible behind the inline messages.
uiTreatment: Semitransparent near-black Top chat panel, circular avatars and inline handle+comment rows; native underlined composer and outlined send.
